accentColorNote: Sampled from the badge's own SVG source, whose single background rectangle is filled solid black (#000000), matching the real DMC badge, which is a black plate on the DeLorean's brushed-stainless bodywork. No separate published brand colour exists for a company that built and sold cars for barely a year and a half.
